description.p: The desktop client player for Ohrbob (ohrbob.org or self-hosted). Listen to your own podcast radio stations.
Ohrbob is your free and open-source radio station manager. With ohrbob you build your own radio stations and listen to them anywhere.

Browse and discover stations, manage profiles, and keep your playback progress in sync with the Ohrbob server. The client offers a modern, theme-aware interface, quick connection by QR code or deep link, and full media controls including play/pause, seeking, and skipping within the station queue.
